'''Jacob Taylor''' (DeckTech handle '''Armaedes''')<ref name="dt-23249">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23249 Jacob's BHBM aka Blame Canada], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 9 May 2002).
